checks.message: Provisional boundary is present and labeled; replace with official redline before professional scoring.
Three required key areas are present and non-overlapping; provisional polygons disclosed in proposal and HTML.
Land-use partition covers the submitted boundary without gaps or overlaps (EPSG:4548 recomputation).
Buildings, green space and public space are inside the site boundary.
site_area_sqm, green_ratio and public_space_ratio match EPSG:4548 geometry recomputation.
Static offline HTML with inline SVG map; no remote resources, scripts, iframes or forms.
data-metric/data-value markers match metrics.json for required core metrics.
Proposal references all standards, design-depth items, geometry files, known metrics and registered sources.
Format, compliance, security and evidence checks pass; provisional-boundary warnings remain disclosed.
